paired_comparison.complete_block_requirement: all promoted methods passed with protocol-valid evidence in the same frozen block
paired_comparison.incomplete_block_treatment: publish the block and mark the confirmatory comparison incomplete; do not calculate a confirmatory result from a post-hoc subset
paired_comparison.ratio_rule: publish a ratio only for a positive finite denominator
summaries: individual paired ratios by block when defined
median absolute deviation of paired deltas
median absolute deviation of paired ratios when defined

content_identity.prefix_rule: typed prefix followed by the first 20 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the documented identity object

file_digest.covers: exact file bytes including the final newline when present

numeric_rules.durations: integer nanoseconds in raw timing records and integer or finite decimal seconds only in sanitized summaries
numeric_rules.telemetry_rates: finite decimal values with an explicit unit field

path_rules.manifest_paths: unique normalized relative POSIX paths with no empty, dot, or parent segment

validation_policy.future_implementation_requirement: every record validator enforces this policy before Phase 2 can pass

sealed raw manifest or allowed capture-failure receipt for every started slot
forbidden_claims: semantic deployment validity from structural export
release readiness from campaign evidence alone

does_not_support: another CUDA method, model, host, or environment
recreation of an absent Python test transcript
closure of the Ubuntu source-test gate without the original transcript
recovery_supplement.supports: the listed August 6 raw artifacts received the recorded recovery dispositions and the recovered set was sealed, copied, verified, and retrieved under the recorded storage and retention policy

claim_boundary_contract.runtime_scope: every claim is limited to the exact source, tree, host, driver, runtime closure, model revision, dataset and split, candidate, plan, policy snapshot, bundle, execution configuration, and predeclared cohort that produced it

event_ledger_contract.format: JSON Lines with one canonical object and one LF per row
event_ledger_contract.sequence_rule: zero-based contiguous integers with no duplicate or missing value
event_ledger_contract.timing_rule: derive every duration from monotonic_ns; wall time is an auditable UTC mapping only
event_ledger_contract.transition_claim_rule: a polled job-state change is observed rather than emitted and cannot establish an unobserved intermediate transition time
event_ledger_contract.utc_mapping: the ledger contains initial and final clock.mapping rows

field_contract.split_group: cuda-campaign-group-NNN string with exactly four rows per group
field_contract.target_content_words: positive integer generation target for prompt plus completion content words; not a tokenizer count

benchmark.privacy: repository-owned synthetic content with no private user or production data

algorithm.completion_tokens: length of completion_ids after the conditional EOS append
algorithm.eos_rule: append tokenizer.eos_token_id when it is non-null and completion_ids does not already end with it

per_row_manifest.phase4_reproduction_rule: reproduce a canonical per-row manifest from freshly verified model and tokenizer artifacts, seal that reproduced manifest, and require its exact bytes and SHA-256 to match this planning preview; any mismatch stops activation pending reconciliation
per_row_manifest.use_boundary: digest, byte size, and summary are Phase 1 planning inputs only; the Phase 4 reproduced and sealed manifest is authoritative

tokenizer_verification.phase4_inventory_rule: bind, hash, and seal the entire freshly resolved tokenizer file inventory; the two recovered Phase 1 files do not authorize assuming a fresh provider inventory contains only those files

contract_smoke.purpose: short nonqualifying harness, parser, and runtime-contract rehearsal only

attempt_slot.scheduled_seed_meaning: the slot's training seed; data_order_seed is independently bound as 1000000 + scheduled_seed and split_seed is 424242

opaque_random_identifiers.public_rule: never derive an opaque ID from a hostname, username, path, IP address, GPU UUID, serial number, or hash of one of those values

adapter.target_modules_phase4_gate: the exact tuple must match the provider-inspected model and selected candidate and is frozen in the Phase 4 cohort plan; mismatch blocks activation

method_parameter_scope.full: all admitted full-model trainable parameters; no adapter rank, alpha, or target modules
method_parameter_scope.int8-lora: adapter parameters only over the exact adapter target tuple
method_parameter_scope.lora: adapter parameters only over the exact adapter target tuple
method_parameter_scope.qlora: adapter parameters only over the exact adapter target tuple

anchor_execution_configuration.precision_admission_rule: BF16 is used only when exact planning and live admission pass; otherwise the slot remains planned-not-started and no precision fallback is substituted

common_stability_and_integrity_contract.artifact_and_integrity_rule: every required capture, seal, copy verification, off-host retrieval, artifact validation, completion validation, and method-integrity contract passes
common_stability_and_integrity_contract.promotion_duration_metric: externally observed monotonic duration of the exact training segment for the same exact 128-step configuration; trainer-reported runtime and steady-state rate are not substitutes

conditioning.action_extent: complete static validation, dependency validation, model-data validation, measured preflight, and bounded pilot only
conditioning.failure_effect: any nonpassing or capture-invalid conditioning attempt blocks that cell pending diagnosis

global_rules.cache_policy: capture installations and downloads separately; qualifying repetitions use the frozen post-conditioning cache state
global_rules.run_paths: fresh state, bundle, output, capture, and raw-vault locations for every started slot

cell.precision: bf16; planned-not-started if exact planning or live admission does not support it; no fallback

phase5_repeatability_anchor.pass_rule: all 5 of 5 slots must satisfy the common stability and integrity contract

phase6_same_model_method_matrix.admission: retain only methods with an exact selectable candidate and passing static, dependency, model-data, measured-preflight, and pilot gates
phase6_same_model_method_matrix.confirmatory_comparison_rule: a confirmatory paired comparison requires every promoted method to have passed with protocol-valid evidence in all five complete blocks; do not analyze a post-hoc complete subset
phase6_same_model_method_matrix.method_order_filter: remove nonadmitted or nonpromoted methods from each frozen order without reordering the remaining methods
phase6_same_model_method_matrix.promotion_rule: exactly 3 of 3 exploratory slots for a cell must satisfy the common stability and integrity contract

architecture_breadth_amendment.activation_condition: the reviewed amendment is merged and the same-family Phase 7 cohort remains reviewed; no attempt ledger or training result may predate both conditions

phase7_scale_staircase.larger_size_progression_rule: the LoRA cell must have all 3 slots satisfy the common stability and integrity contract before the next model size may activate
phase7_scale_staircase.method_failure_rule: a method with any refusal, failure, capture-invalid result, safety or integrity event, or common-threshold instability has planned-not-started slots at every larger size; no replacement is allowed
phase7_scale_staircase.schedule_rule: at each size complete all three LoRA slots first, then each remaining retained Phase 6 method in frozen method order; every retained method uses the three frozen seeds

effective_batch_size.strategy: use the frozen valid micro-batch and accumulation realization selected before the axis starts

phase8_guarded_frontiers.phase7_base_selection: use the largest exact Phase 7 cell that satisfies the common stability and integrity contract and whose every qualifying input run passes all Phase 9 headroom inputs; freeze its identity before the first frontier point
phase8_guarded_frontiers.right_censor_rule: if every frozen point on an axis passes, report the largest tested rung as a right-censored endpoint and do not claim an unobserved failure boundary
phase8_guarded_frontiers.stopping_rule: each axis has its own passing baseline; increase one point at a time, do not replace a slot, stop that axis at the first admission refusal or bounded-pilot nonpass, and do not activate any larger point
phase8_guarded_frontiers.training_extent: bounded pilot only at a point needed to establish the first runtime nonpass; never confirmed full training to seek OOM

phase9_endurance.cross_run_drift_rule: drift is descriptive only and may be reported only when the Phase 3 progress-timing contract exists; it is not a Phase 9 pass condition
phase9_endurance.duration_contract: after Phase 3, freeze either a reviewed graceful deadline from 1800 through 3600 seconds or a reviewed optimizer-step target of at least 300; without either, freeze dataset and epochs and report observed elapsed time without an enforced-duration or update-count claim
phase9_endurance.headroom_rule: the exact selected cell must satisfy every phase9_selection_headroom threshold across all qualifying input runs with no safety warning
phase9_endurance.pass_rule: all 3 of 3 slots must be native passed and protocol-valid, with no safety warning or stop, no capture, artifact, or integrity defect, complete required copy verification, and successful current off-host retrieval

selection_contract.axis_candidate_rule: for each Phase 8 axis, start with the highest passing rung strictly below the observed endpoint: the predecessor of the first nonpass, or the predecessor of the right-censored top rung when every rung passes; walk downward until every Phase 9 headroom rule passes
selection_contract.freeze_rule: freeze the selected execution configuration before the first Phase 9 slot

phase9_endurance.stability_ratio_boundary: the Phase 5, Phase 6, and common duration-ratio stability thresholds do not apply to Phase 9 unless a separately reviewed pre-results protocol explicitly states otherwise

seed_policy.paired_block_rule: every method in a paired block shares the same scheduled training seed and therefore the same derived data-order seed
seed_policy.rng_stream_rule: training and data-order seeds initialize separate RNG objects and streams

measurement_contract.setup_timing: installation and download are separate setup records only when capture begins before their command; otherwise they are excluded from every performance aggregate

training_window.end_to_end_and_resource_scope: includes model load, every optimizer step including steps 1 through 8, evaluation, export, and verification as separately labeled segments

operator acceptance plus provider inspection and recorded license review required
provider inspection and recorded license review required

models.campaign_role: Phase 5 anchor and Phase 6 same-model matrix

phase_order_and_gates.host_mutation_gate: no install, update, cleanup, pull, or Aptus execution on the Ubuntu host until Phase 0 has two verified copies and successful off-host retrieval, the independently reviewed Phase 2 sanitized recovery supplement is published and merged, and the Phase 3 implementation is merged; before that point Phase 0 writes are limited to protected recovery copies
phase_order_and_gates.qualifying_execution_gate: Phases 0, 2, 3, and 4 must pass without an unresolved protocol, capture, selection, fixture, source, environment, or safety change
phase_order_and_gates.source_freeze: one clean full commit and tree are frozen in Phase 4 after Phase 2 and Phase 3 merge

protocol_metadata.authority: frozen machine-readable Phase 1 protocol for the RTX 3050 CUDA empirical campaign
protocol_metadata.supersession_rule: any semantic change requires a new schema version, a new campaign or cohort identity as applicable, and a repeated Phase 4 rehearsal

receipt_contract.public_binding: publish the receipt SHA-256, byte size, safe date/result projection, and opaque IDs; keep exact private paths and custodian identity protected

retrieval.mode: full restore from the off-host copy into a fresh destination followed by complete manifest verification

additional_search_items.rule: search for the original byte-exact transcript; if it never existed as a file, record not-found and the bounded search-scope codes; never recreate it from the 550-test summary

recovery_supplement_contract.duplicate_digest_rule: each logical expected item remains a separate row and multiple rows may reference one recovered physical artifact entry
recovery_supplement_contract.summary_invariant: logical_digest_count equals recovered-matching plus recovered-mismatched plus not-found

retention_contract.calendar_month_rule: add 24 calendar months in UTC and clamp the day only when the target month has fewer days

triggers: after any storage, encryption-key, or custodian change

retention_contract.deletion_gate: deletion is forbidden unless retain_not_before_utc has passed and every dependent claim has been withdrawn or superseded
retention_contract.early_controlling_deletion: when consent, license, security, or another controlling requirement forces earlier deletion, publish claim withdrawal before deletion whenever permitted

effective_policy.deadline_basis: packet merge time plus 24 calendar months
effective_policy.retain_not_before_meaning: future minimum retention deadline distinct from issue and effective times

retention_contract.temporary_failure_effect: loss of redundancy or failed retrieval suspends every dependent claim until restoration, successful retrieval, and independent review are recorded

cooldown.failure_effect: if the complete cooldown window is not obtained within 1800 seconds, the next slot remains planned-not-started and the campaign stops for diagnosis
cooldown.gpu_temperature_slope_estimator: ordinary least-squares slope over all 120 valid (monotonic_seconds, gpu_temperature_c) samples, converted to degrees Celsius per minute; compare without rounding, and fail cooldown when timestamp variance is zero or any required sample is invalid
requirements: no unrelated CUDA process
at least 110 of 120 consecutive one-hertz samples report exactly zero GPU utilization

no active thermal throttle
no new Xid, reset, lost-device, or applicable hardware error
VRAM, host memory, disk, and swap are on the safe side of warning thresholds

state_axes.unstarted_identity_rule: planned-not-started slots have an attempt-slot ID but no execution-configuration ID or experiment-run ID

copies.same_site_limitation: two machines at one site establish host and storage separation but not geographic redundancy

copy_equality.content_definition: identical normalized relative file set, exact payload bytes, exact raw-manifest bytes, and exact seal bytes

fsync SEALED.json and the run directory

coverage.scheduled_slot_contract: slot k has scheduled_monotonic_ns = telemetry_start_monotonic_ns + k * 1000000000 for every integer k from zero through expected_sample_count minus one; every sample records that slot index and scheduled timestamp, no slot contributes more than one numerator count, and a missed slot is never filled by a catch-up sample
coverage.valid_sample: one unique sequence and monotonic timestamp with every required common field parseable; unsupported optional sensor values remain explicit and do not invalidate the sample

estimated_gpu_energy.label: estimated GPU energy
estimated_gpu_energy.method: trapezoidal integration of GPU power draw in watts over monotonic sample intervals, yielding joules
estimated_gpu_energy.publish_time_support: publish integrated covered duration, scheduled-window duration, scheduled-slot coverage, and separately labeled clipped time-support coverage
estimated_gpu_energy.segment_rule: integrate only adjacent valid power samples separated by no more than two scheduled one-second intervals; do not bridge a larger interval

gpu_memory_integrity.cross_check: compare total_bytes with used_bytes + free_bytes + reserved_bytes only as an integrity cross-check; directly reported free_bytes remains the safety input
gpu_memory_integrity.mismatch_effect: emit an integrity mismatch flag, mark the attempt capture-invalid, and block qualification pending diagnosis
gpu_memory_integrity.mismatch_tolerance_rule: allow at most the sum of one-half of each used, free, reserved, and total source value's retained display resolution, which is 2 MiB when all four nvidia-smi values are integral MiB
gpu_memory_integrity.normalization_rule: retain each directly reported source unit and convert used, free, reserved, and total to integer bytes exactly before comparison; an inexact or invalid conversion fails the integrity check
gpu_memory_integrity.safety_free_vram_source: the directly reported free-memory channel, never the derived cross-check value

optional_channels.cpu_and_nvme_temperatures: may be declared unsupported before a cohort; a supported or required channel becoming unreadable makes the attempt capture-invalid
optional_channels.unsupported_value_representation: explicit unsupported status with null value and stable reason

required_gpu_channels: GPU UUID in protected data only
memory used, free, reserved, and total as reported, with each value normalized to integer bytes and its source unit retained
required_host_channels: managed-process RSS, CPU, and I/O counters
telemetry_contract.sampling_policy: monotonic fixed-rate schedule with no catch-up burst after a missed sample

summaries.p05: sort n values, h=(n-1)*0.05, j=floor(h), g=h-j, result=x[j]+g*(x[ceil(h)]-x[j])
summaries.p95: sort n values, h=(n-1)*0.95, j=floor(h), g=h-j, result=x[j]+g*(x[ceil(h)]-x[j])
